story_concept: After a quiet fight, the house has started moving softly around Aachu's silence. Zuv enters carefully from the doorway, close enough to remain recognizable, lifting one socked foot only slightly. One hand keeps the half-open door from creaking; the other carries a cup with the teaspoon pinned still against the rim. Aachu sits quietly, present but withdrawn. The room's objects carry the line without turning it into a quote card.
on_image_text:
तू चुप हो जाए तो घर में आवाज़ें भी डर-डर के चलती हैं।”
When you go silent,
even the house starts walking carefully.
visual_proof: The image should still read as 'even the house is careful around this silence' if the text is covered.
